detailed_description: The TOML/JSON Converter provides a lightweight browser-side conversion between simple TOML and JSON. Choose TOML to JSON or JSON to TOML, paste text into the input textarea, optionally choose 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or minified JSON indentation for TOML-to-JSON output, then click Convert. TOML parsing supports comments, basic key=value assignments, dotted keys, simple section headers, quoted strings, booleans, numbers, and inline arrays. JSON-to-TOML parses with JSON.parse and writes scalar values plus nested plain objects as TOML tables. Load Sample, Swap, Copy, and Clear are available. It does not use WebAssembly, build an AST, validate schemas, preserve TOML comments, support array-of-tables or every TOML data type, provide line-numbered diagnostics, or download files.
usage_steps: Select TOML to JSON or JSON to TOML from the mode dropdown.
If converting TOML to JSON, choose 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or Minified indentation.
Paste text into the input textarea or click Load Sample.
Click Convert to generate the output textarea.
Use Swap to move the output back into the input when you want to reverse direction.
Click Copy to copy the generated output, or Clear to reset both textareas.
usage_examples: Convert a small TOML config with sections and arrays into JSON for quick inspection.
Turn a simple JSON object into TOML table output for a draft configuration file.
Load the sample TOML, convert it, then switch indentation between 2 spaces and minified output.
Use Swap after conversion to make a quick round-trip check on a simple snippet.

faqs.question: Does the converter preserve comments from my TOML file?
faqs.answer: No, JSON does not natively support comments, so they are stripped during TOML-to-JSON conversion.

faqs.question: How does the tool handle invalid TOML or JSON syntax?
faqs.answer: The tool provides clear error messages highlighting the location and nature of any syntax errors it encounters.

faqs.question: Can I convert nested structures and arrays between the formats?
faqs.answer: Yes, the converter fully supports complex nested objects, arrays, and all standard data types in both formats.

faqs.question: Is there a file size limit for conversion?
faqs.answer: The conversion is performed client-side in your browser, so it's limited by your device's available memory.

faqs.question: Is my data secure when using this online converter?
faqs.answer: Yes, all conversion happens locally in your web browser; no data is sent to any server, ensuring complete privacy.
